variant.title: Modular Lines Sudoku
variant.description: Every consecutive group of three digits on a line must have different remainders when divided by 3.
rule.modular_lines: Every consecutive group of three digits on a line must have different remainders when divided by 3.
rule_guide.title: Modular Lines Sudoku
rule_guide.item_1: Each row, column, and 3x3 box must contain no repeated digit.
rule_guide.item_2: For every three consecutive cells on a line, divide the three digits by 3; their remainders must all be different.
rule_guide.item_3: For example, 1, 5, and 9 leave remainders 1, 2, and 0, so this window satisfies the rule.
